Definition: from a primary πένω (to toil for daily subsistence); starving, i.e. indigent:--poor. Compare G4434.
BiblicalUsage: Penes means poor, starving, indigent — the man who toils for his daily bread. Paul quotes the psalm: He hath dispersed abroad, He hath given to the poor, His righteousness remaineth for ever.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God gives to the poor and the gift outlasts the giver: His righteousness remaineth for ever.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
